- Added a five-second countdown with Undo when deleting all your own messages in a group, so you can now cancel the deletion before it starts
- Changed how the attach button works; it now only opens the attachment menu, and files are picked from the menu items instead of opening the file picker on click
- Removed the bot command button from the message field and its display option; opening bot commands from that button is no longer available

---

- 新增了删除自己在群组中所有消息时的 5 秒撤销倒计时，现在可以在删除真正开始前取消
- 调整了附件按钮的行为，现在它只负责展开附件菜单，文件需要从菜单项中选择，点击按钮不再直接打开文件选择窗口
- 移除了输入框中的机器人命令按钮及其显示选项，通过该按钮打开机器人命令不再可用
